sentiment: A tiny mind learns the world by pretending, until the pretending becomes a place you can live in.

stories.title: WorldTUI: I trained a 360M model to pretend to be a terminal
stories.summary: A tiny model taught to mimic a terminal invents a world it can hold in text — pretending so faithfully that the pretending becomes a place.

stories.title: The recently proposed o(n log n) integer multiplication algorithm [pdf]
stories.summary: A wall mathematicians leaned on for decades finally gives way — the reward for refusing to accept that the limit was real.

stories.title: No more icons in every menu by default
stories.summary: Stripping ornament back to plain words — restraint as a way of letting the real thing, not the decoration, do the talking.
